migrations.name: 0001_listings
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS listings (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', lat REAL, lng REAL, price REAL, price_unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', images TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listings_owner ON listings (owner_id, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listings_public ON listings (status, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0002_favorites
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favorites (user_id TEXT NOT NULL, listing_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, listing_id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favorites_listing ON favorites (listing_id)

migrations.name: 0003_requests
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requests (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, listing_id TEXT NOT NULL, requester_id TEXT NOT NULL, requester_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_requests_listing ON requests (listing_id, status); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_requests_requester ON requests (requester_id, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0004_messages
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, listing_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_thread ON messages (listing_id, sender_id, recipient_id, created_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_recipient ON messages (recipient_id, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0005_reviews
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, listing_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, author_id TEXT NOT NULL, author_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', rating INTEGER NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reviews_listing ON reviews (listing_id, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0006_safety
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blocks (blocker_id TEXT NOT NULL, blocked_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (blocker_id, blocked_id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_blocks_blocked ON blocks (blocked_id); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, reporter_id TEXT NOT NULL, reported_id TEXT NOT NULL, listing_id TEXT, reason TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_reports_reported ON reports (reported_id, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0007_tradies_roles_and_jobs
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profiles (user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('customer', 'tradie')), trade_category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_role_category ON profiles (role, trade_category); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed')), title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_public ON jobs (status, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_customer ON jobs (customer_id, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0008_job_lifecycle_and_private_details
migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE jobs ADD COLUMN lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (lifecycle IN ('draft', 'open', 'closed')); ALTER TABLE jobs ADD COLUMN private_address TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; ALTER TABLE jobs ADD COLUMN contact_details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_discovery ON jobs (status, lifecycle, category, location, created_at DESC)

migrations.name: 0009_quotes
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quotes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('job', 'request')), target_id TEXT NOT NULL, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL, tradie_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted' CHECK (status IN ('submitted', 'withdrawn', 'accepted', 'declined')), scope TEXT NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, timing TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', valid_until INTEGER, notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, accepted_at INTEGER, CHECK (customer_id != tradie_id)); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotes_target_tradie ON quotes (target_type, target_id, tradie_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotes_customer ON quotes (customer_id, target_type, target_id, created_at DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotes_tradie ON quotes (tradie_id, updated_at DESC); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotes_one_accepted ON quotes (target_type, target_id) WHERE status = 'accepted'

migrations.name: 0010_work_conversations_and_agreements
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_messages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('job', 'request')), target_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', recipient_id TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (sender_id != recipient_id)); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_messages_idempotency ON work_messages (id, sender_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_messages_thread ON work_messages (target_type, target_id, created_at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_agreements (target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('job', 'request')), target_id TEXT NOT NULL, quote_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL, tradie_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('agreed', 'customer_completed', 'tradie_completed', 'completed')), agreed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (target_type, target_id), CHECK (customer_id != tradie_id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_agreements_customer ON work_agreements (customer_id, updated_at DESC); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_agreements_tradie ON work_agreements (tradie_id, updated_at DESC)
